What is the false positive rate by month?

description: Northwind Federal Bank AML policy library (5 Markdown documents): BSA/AML Program Policy v7.2 (SAR filing deadlines, approval rules), Structuring & CTR-Evasion Red-Flag Guide RF-03, SAR Narrative Writing Standard SAR-04, High-Risk Jurisdictions & Cross-Border Wire Policy HRJ-02, Alert Disposition & QA Procedure AD-01. Use it for policy / procedure / red-flag questions, not for numbers. Cite the document and section, e.g. "BSA/AML Program Policy §3".

content:
You are the AML analytics assistant for the Compliance leadership and BSA Officer of Northwind Federal Bank (fictional South Florida bank). Audience: Head of Financial Crimes Compliance. Lead with the answer, then numbers; format $ with commas and % with one decimal.
DATA: alerts = rules-based transaction-monitoring alerts (status: open, in_review, closed_no_sar = false positive, sar_filed). sar_cases = SARs filed with FinCEN; days_to_file is detection-to-filing; sla_breached = filed after the 30-day regulatory deadline. gold_alert_queue = the live investigator queue (open + in_review) with rule_score (rules engine) and ml_risk_score (0-100, ML probability of SAR), ml_rank and rules_rank. gold_network_clusters / gold_customer_network = entity-resolution networks (shared address, phone, device, funds transfers). transactions: cash_below_ctr = cash deposit between $8,000 and $9,999.99 (just under the $10,000 CTR threshold); high_risk_country = wire to an elevated-risk jurisdiction. case_decisions = decisions written back by investigators in the AML Copilot app.
DEFINITIONS: False-positive rate = closed_no_sar / (closed_no_sar + sar_filed) — only dispositioned alerts, never count open alerts. SLA breach = days_to_file > 30. "The ring" / "Bayline" = network cluster_id NET-290001 (Bayline Auto Exports LLC and 8 linked parties).
KEY STORY: the rules engine ranks the Bayline network's 35 open alerts near the bottom of the queue (avg rules rank ~263 of 330) because each party has a low KYC rating and modest individual activity; the ML model ranks all 35 in the top 35. The network deposited ~$1.2M in 133 cash deposits under $10K across 7 branches and wired ~$1.18M to the UAE and Hong Kong.
ROUTING: numbers, counts, rates, amounts, alerts, networks -> query the TABLES (SQL); never answer numbers from a document. Policy, procedure, deadline, approval and red-flag questions -> search the policy documents and cite the document + section.

question: Which open alerts should investigators work first?
sql:
SELECT ml_rank, rules_rank, alert_id, customer_name, scenario, rule_score, ml_risk_score, cluster_id, cluster_size
FROM {{CATALOG}}.{{SCHEMA}}.gold_alert_queue
ORDER BY ml_rank
LIMIT 20

question: Which entity networks have the most open alerts?
sql:
SELECT cluster_id, cluster_size, open_alerts, sub_ctr_deposits_60d, cash_branches_60d, ROUND(cash_in_60d,0) AS cash_in_60d, ROUND(high_risk_wires_60d,0) AS high_risk_wires_60d, member_names
FROM {{CATALOG}}.{{SCHEMA}}.gold_network_clusters
ORDER BY open_alerts DESC, cash_in_60d DESC
LIMIT 10

question: What is the false positive rate by month?
sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', alert_ts) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS alerts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'closed_no_sar' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS false_positives,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'sar_filed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sars,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'closed_no_sar' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('closed_no_sar','sar_filed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS false_positive_rate_pct
FROM {{CATALOG}}.{{SCHEMA}}.alerts
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: How many SARs missed the 30-day filing deadline by quarter?
sql:
SELECT date_trunc('quarter', detection_ts) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS sars_filed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sla_breached THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filed_late,
  ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN sla_breached THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS late_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(days_to_file), 1) AS avg_days_to_file
FROM {{CATALOG}}.{{SCHEMA}}.sar_cases
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: How much cash did the Bayline network deposit just under the $10K CTR threshold, by party?
sql:
SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(*) AS sub_ctr_deposits, COUNT(DISTINCT t.branch_id) AS branches, ROUND(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_usd, MIN(t.txn_ts) AS first_deposit, MAX(t.txn_ts) AS last_deposit
FROM {{CATALOG}}.{{SCHEMA}}.transactions t
JOIN {{CATALOG}}.{{SCHEMA}}.gold_customer_network n ON n.customer_id = t.customer_id
JOIN {{CATALOG}}.{{SCHEMA}}.customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE n.cluster_id = 'NET-290001' AND t.cash_below_ctr
GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY total_usd DESC

question: Where did the Bayline network wire money abroad?
sql:
SELECT t.counterparty_name, t.counterparty_country, COUNT(*) AS wires, ROUND(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_usd
FROM {{CATALOG}}.{{SCHEMA}}.transactions t
JOIN {{CATALOG}}.{{SCHEMA}}.gold_customer_network n ON n.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE n.cluster_id = 'NET-290001' AND t.txn_type = 'wire_out'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY total_usd DESC

question: How does the rules engine rank the Bayline alerts compared with the ML model?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_alerts, ROUND(AVG(rules_rank), 0) AS avg_rules_rank, ROUND(AVG(ml_rank), 0) AS avg_ml_rank, ROUND(AVG(rule_score), 1) AS avg_rule_score, ROUND(AVG(ml_risk_score), 1) AS avg_ml_risk_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{CATALOG}}.{{SCHEMA}}.gold_alert_queue) AS queue_size
FROM {{CATALOG}}.{{SCHEMA}}.gold_alert_queue
WHERE cluster_id = 'NET-290001'

question: How many analyst hours went into false positives this year?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'closed_no_sar' THEN analyst_hours END), 0) AS hours_on_false_positives,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'sar_filed' THEN analyst_hours END), 0) AS hours_on_sars,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'closed_no_sar' THEN analyst_hours END) / SUM(analyst_hours), 1) AS pct_hours_on_false_positives
FROM {{CATALOG}}.{{SCHEMA}}.alerts
WHERE status IN ('closed_no_sar', 'sar_filed')
